10422-caesar-dies.title: Caesar Dies
10422-caesar-dies.creator: Talbot Mundy
10422-caesar-dies.description: A book by Talbot Mundy. North, south, east and west, the trade-routes intersected, entering the city through the ornate gates in crenelated limestone walls. From miles away the approaching caravans were overlooked by legionaries brought from Gaul and Britain, quartered in the capitol on Mount Silpius at the city's southern limit. The riches of the East, and of Egypt, flowed through, leaving their deposit as a river drops its silt;  were ever- increasing.

arxiv-1510-06488.title: When ICN Meets C-RAN for HetNets: An SDN Approach Thanks: This work has been accepted by IEEE Communications Magazine. C. Yang, Z. Chen, and B. Xia (corresponding author) are with the Department of Electronic Engineering, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, P. R. China. Thanks: J. Wang is with
arxiv-1510-06488.creator: Chenchen Yang, Student Member, IEEE, Zhiyong Chen, Member, IEEE, Bin Xia, Senior Member, IEEE, Jiangzhou Wang, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-1510-06488.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Chenchen Yang, Student Member, IEEE, Zhiyong Chen, Member, IEEE, Bin Xia, Senior Member, IEEE, Jiangzhou Wang, Senior Member, IEEE. With the ever-growing of mobile Internet and the explosion of its applications, users are experiencing abundant services from different content providers via different network service providers in the heterogeneous network (HetNet). Information-centric network (ICN) advocates to get rid of the current host-centric network protocol for the fact that the information dissemination rather than the end-to-end communication contributes to the majority of today’s network traffic.

arxiv-2011-11500.title: Statistical and computational thresholds for the planted k k -densest sub-hypergraph problem
arxiv-2011-11500.creator: Luca Corinzia, and Paolo Penna, Wojciech Szpankowski, Joachim M. Buhmann
arxiv-2011-11500.description: Abstract In this work, we consider the problem of recovery a planted k k -densest sub-hypergraph on d d -uniform hypergraphs. This fundamental problem appears in different contexts, e.g., community detection, average-case complexity, and neuroscience applications as a structural variant of tensor-PCA problem.

arxiv-2012-01238.title: A Bimodal Weibull Distribution: Properties and Inference
arxiv-2012-01238.creator: Roberto Vila a1, Mehmet Niyazi Çankaya a2,a3
arxiv-2012-01238.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Roberto Vila a1, Mehmet Niyazi Çankaya a2,a3. Abstract Modeling is a challenging topic and using parametric models is an important stage to reach flexible function for modeling. Weibull distribution has two parameters which are shape α \alpha and scale β \beta . In this study, bimodality parameter is added and so bimodal Weibull distribution is proposed by using a quadratic transformation technique used to generate bimodal functions produced due to using the quadratic expression.

arxiv-2101-09341.title: Beurling-Type Density Criteria for System Identification
arxiv-2101-09341.creator: Verner Vlačić 1 , Céline Aubel 2 , and Helmut Bölcskei 1
arxiv-2101-09341.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Verner Vlačić 1 , Céline Aubel 2 , and Helmut Bölcskei 1. This paper addresses the problem of identifying a linear time-varying (LTV) system characterized by a (possibly infinite) discrete set of delay-Doppler shifts without a lattice (or other “geometry-discretizing”) constraint on the support set. Concretely, we show that a class of such LTV systems is identifiable whenever the upper uniform Beurling density of the delay-Doppler support sets, measured “uniformly over the class”, is strictly less than 1 / 2 1/2 .

arxiv-2105-06753.title: A-priori sparsification of Galerkin-based reduced order models
arxiv-2105-06753.creator: Riccardo Rubini 1, Davide Lasagna 1, Andrea Da Ronch 1
arxiv-2105-06753.description: Abstract A methodology to generate sparse Galerkin models of chaotic/unsteady fluid flows containing a minimal number of active triadic interactions is proposed. The key idea is to find an appropriate set of basis functions for the projection representing elementary flow structures that interact minimally one with the other and thus result in a triadic interaction coefficient tensor with sparse structure.

arxiv-2207-07140.title: Chandra Observations of Six Peter Pan Disks: Diversity of X-ray-driven Internal Photoevaporation Rates Doesn’t Explain Their Rare Longevity
arxiv-2207-07140.creator: Stefan Laos, John P. Wisniewski, Marc J. Kuchner, Steven M. Silverberg, Hans Moritz Günther, David A. Principe, Brett Bonine, Marina Kounkel, The Disk Detective Collaboration
arxiv-2207-07140.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Stefan Laos, John P. Wisniewski, Marc J. Kuchner, Steven M. Silverberg, Hans Moritz Günther, David A. Principe, Brett Bonine, Marina Kounkel, The Disk Detective Collaboration. We present Chandra X-ray observations of 6 previously-identified Peter Pan objects, rare ∼ \sim 40 Myr systems with evidence of primordial disk retention. We observe X-ray luminosities (0.8-3.0 keV) ranging from log L x L_{x} ∼ \sim 27.7–29.1.

arxiv-2302-03399.title: Crack tip kinematics reveal the cohesive zone structure in brittle hydrogel fracture Journal: Journal of the Mechanics and Physics of Solids
arxiv-2302-03399.creator: Chenzhuo Li, Xinyue Wei, Meng Wang, Mokhtar Adda-Bedia, John M. Kolinski
arxiv-2302-03399.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chenzhuo Li, Xinyue Wei, Meng Wang, Mokhtar Adda-Bedia, John M. Kolinski. When brittle hydrogels fail, several mechanisms conspire to alter the state of stress near the tip of a crack, and it is challenging to identify which mechanism is dominant. In the fracture of brittle solids, a sufficient far-field stress results in the complete loss of structural strength as the material ‘unzips’ at the tip of a crack, where stresses are concentrated.

arxiv-2304-09926.title: Why POCS works, and how to make it better
arxiv-2304-09926.creator: Matteo Ravasi, Nick Luiken
arxiv-2304-09926.description: Abstract Projection Over Convex Sets (POCS) is one of the most widely used algorithms in geophysical data processing to interpolate seismic data. Whilst usually described as a modification of the Gerchberg-Saxton algorithm, a formal understanding of the underlying objective function and its implication for the associated optimization process is lacking to date in the literature.

arxiv-2307-01172.title: The weak noise theory of the O’Connell-Yor polymer as an integrable discretisation of the nonlinear Schrodinger equation
arxiv-2307-01172.creator: Alexandre Krajenbrink, Pierre Le Doussal
arxiv-2307-01172.description: Abstract We investigate and solve the weak noise theory for the semi-discrete O’Connell-Yor directed polymer. In the large deviation regime, the most probable evolution of the partition function obeys a classical non-linear system which is a non-standard discretisation of the nonlinear Schrodinger equation with mixed initial-final conditions.

arxiv-2405-12111.title: AGNfitter-rx : Modelling the radio-to-X-ray SEDs of AGNs
arxiv-2405-12111.creator: L. N. Martínez-Ramírez, G. Calistro Rivera, Elisabeta Lusso, F. E. Bauer, Emanuele Nardini, Johannes Buchner, Michael J.I. Brown, Juan C. B. Pineda, Matthew J. Temple, Manda Banerji, M. Stalevski, Joseph F. Hennawi
arxiv-2405-12111.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by L. N. Martínez-Ramírez, G. Calistro Rivera, Elisabeta Lusso, F. E. Bauer, Emanuele Nardini, Johannes Buchner, Michael J.I. Brown, Juan C. B. Pineda, Matthew J. Temple, Manda Banerji, M. Stalevski, Joseph F. Hennawi. We present new frontiers in the modelling of the spectral energy distributions (SED) of active galaxies by introducing the radio-to-X-ray fitting capabilities of the publicly available Bayesian code AGNfitter .

arxiv-2411-10833.title: A note on the L1 discretization error for the Caputo derivative in Hölder spaces This is an accepted version of a manuscript published in Applied Mathematics Letters 161 (2025), 109364 with DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.aml.2024.109364
arxiv-2411-10833.creator: Félix del Teso, Łukasz Płociniczak
arxiv-2411-10833.description: Abstract We establish uniform error bounds of the L1 discretization of the Caputo derivative of Hölder continuous functions. The result can be understood as: error = degree of smoothness - order of the derivative. We present an elementary proof and illustrate its optimality with numerical examples.

arxiv-2502-00370.title: Modelling car-following dynamics with stochastic input-state-output port-Hamiltonian systems
arxiv-2502-00370.creator: Julia Ackermann 1 , Matthias Ehrhardt 1 , Thomas Kruse 1 and Antoine Tordeux 2
arxiv-2502-00370.description: Abstract In this contribution, we introduce a general class of car-following models with an input-state-output port-Hamiltonian structure. We derive stability conditions and long-term behavior of the finite system with periodic boundaries and quadratic interaction potential by spectral analysis and using asymptotic properties of multivariate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes. The uncontrolled dynamics exhibit instability and random collective behavior under stochastic perturbations.

Aims.

arxiv-2502-10681.title: Multistability and Control in Ring Networks of Phase Oscillators with Frequency Heterogeneity and Phase Delay
arxiv-2502-10681.creator: Soomin Kim, Hiroshi Kori
arxiv-2502-10681.description: Abstract Many oscillator networks are multistable, meaning that different synchronization states are realized depending on the initial conditions. In this paper, we numerically analyze a ring network of phase oscillators, in which synchronous states with different wavenumbers are simultaneously stable.

arxiv-2504-21816.title: Enumeration of minimum weight codewords of affine Cartesian codes Thanks: Sakshi Dang is supported by Senior Research Fellowship from the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research, Govt. of India, for her doctoral work at IIT Bombay. Thanks: Sudhir Ghorpade is partially supported by the grant DS
arxiv-2504-21816.creator: Sakshi Dang, Sudhir R. Ghorpade
arxiv-2504-21816.description: Abstract . Affine Cartesian codes were first discussed by Geil and Thomsen in 2013 in a broader framework and were formally introduced by López, Rentería-Márquez and Villarreal in 2014. These are linear error-correcting codes obtained by evaluating polynomials at points of a Cartesian product of subsets of the given finite field.

arxiv-2602-22401.title: Vibe Researching as Wolf Coming: Can AI Agents with Skills Replace or Augment Social Scientists?
arxiv-2602-22401.creator: Yongjun Zhang
arxiv-2602-22401.description: Abstract AI agents—systems that execute multi-step reasoning workflows with persistent state, tool access, and specialist skills—represent a qualitative shift from prior automation technologies in social science. Unlike chatbots that respond to isolated queries, AI agents can now read files, run code, query databases, search the web, and invoke domain-specific skills to execute entire research pipelines autonomously.

pmc-10607323.creator: Joanna Giełzak, Agata Szczesio-Wlodarczyk, Kinga Bociong, Dimitrios Dionysopoulos, Josette Camilleri
pmc-10607323.description: Direct restorations are currently the most popular restorations used in dental prosthodontics. Due to the increased requirements for materials used in the fabrication of fixed restorations, there is a need for evaluation of strength parameters of these materials, including dental cements.

pmc-10610301.title: The Developmental Mechanism of the Root System of Cultivated Terrestrial Watercress
pmc-10610301.creator: Jiajun Ran, Qiang Ding, Guangpeng Wang, Yunlou Shen, Zhanyuan Gao, Yue Gao, Xiaoqing Ma, Xilin Hou, Tongda Xu
pmc-10610301.description: A well-developed root system is crucial for the rapid growth, asexual reproduction, and adaptation to the drought environments of the watercress. After analyzing the transcriptome of the watercress root system, we found that a high concentration of auxin is key to its adaptation to dry conditions.

pmc-11432157.title: Phubbing in Adolescents: Spanish Validation of the Phubbing Scale (PS)
pmc-11432157.creator: Noelia Barbed-Castrejón, Fermín Navaridas-Nalda, Cristina Ábalos-Villanueva, Oliver Mason, Javier Ortuño-Sierra, Avi Besser
pmc-11432157.description: The Phubbing Scale (PS) is an instrument used to measure the frequency and extent of the behavior of ignoring someone you are with and giving attention to your mobile phone instead. However, there is insufficient evidence about the psychometric adequacy of the Spanish version of the instrument.

pmc-11494117.title: An adaptive robust watermarking scheme based on chaotic mapping
pmc-11494117.creator: Yumin Dong, Rui Yan, Chenhao Yin
pmc-11494117.description: Digital images have become an important way of transmitting information, and the risk of attacks during transmission is increasing. Image watermarking is an important technical means of protecting image information security and plays an important role in the field of information security.

pmc-11506294.title: Can Patient Characteristics and Pre-Treatment MRI Features Predict Survival After Stereotactic Ablative Radiotherapy (SABR) Treatment in Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC): Preliminary Assessment
pmc-11506294.creator: Rachel Gravell, Russell Frood, Anna Littlejohns, Nathalie Casanova, Rebecca Goody, Christine Podesta, Raneem Albazaz, Andrew Scarsbrook
pmc-11506294.description: Background: The study purpose was to develop a machine learning (ML)-based predictive model for event-free survival (EFS) in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) undergoing stereotactic ablative radiotherapy (SABR). Methods: Patients receiving SABR for HCC at a single institution, between 2017 and 2020, were included in the study. They were split into training and test (85%:15%) cohorts.

pmc-11519621.title: Novel application of citric acid based natural deep eutectic solvent in drilling fluids for shale swelling prevention
pmc-11519621.creator: Muhammad Hammad Rasool, Maqsood Ahmad, Numair Ahmed Siddiqui, Husnain Ali
pmc-11519621.description: Swelling of shale in clastic reservoirs poses a significant challenge, causing instability in wellbores. Utilizing water-based drilling mud with shale inhibitors is preferable for environmental reasons over oil-based mud. Ionic liquids (ILs) have garnered interest as shale inhibitors due to their customizable properties and strong electrostatic features.

pmc-11691431.title: EFFECT OF AWARENESS OF HEARING LOSS AMONG CARE RECIPIENTS ON ATTRIBUTES OF CARE PROVIDED: A NATIONAL STUDY
pmc-11691431.creator: Danielle Powell, Wuyang Zhang, Nicholas Reed
pmc-11691431.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Hearing loss (HL) is prevalent among older adults and may result in caregiving challenges due to communication barriers. This study aims to investigate whether care recipients’ awareness of HL is associated with attributes of care.

pmc-11935685.title: Long‐Term Durability of Transcatheter Aortic Valve Prostheses in Patients With Bicuspid Versus Tricuspid Aortic Valve
pmc-11935685.creator: Hong‐De Li, Wei‐Ya Li, Jun‐Li Li, Shi‐Qin Peng, Yuan Feng, Yong Peng, Jia‐Fu Wei, Zhen‐Gang Zhao, Tian‐Yuan Xiong, Yuan‐Wei Xiang Ou, Yan Wang, Qing Li, Hao‐Ran Yang, Cheng‐Xiang Song, Yi‐Jun Yao, Zhong‐Kai Zhu, Qi Liu, Xi Wang, Mao Chen
pmc-11935685.description: BackgroundCurrently, there is a lack of evidence for the long‐term bioprosthetic valve durability of patients with bicuspid aortic valve (BAV) following transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR).Methods and ResultsThis study aimed to evaluate hemodynamic outcome, structural valve deterioration, and bioprosthetic valve failure during long‐term follow‐up after TAVR in patients with BAV versus patients with tricuspid aortic valve (TAV).

pmc-12386549.title: Serum Osteocalcin in Pediatric Osteogenesis Imperfecta: Impact of Disease Type and Bisphosphonate Therapy
pmc-12386549.creator: Jakub Krzysztof Nowicki, Elżbieta Jakubowska-Pietkiewicz, Giacomina Brunetti
pmc-12386549.description: The aim of this study was to analyze the factors that may influence serum osteocalcin levels in children with osteogenesis imperfecta treated with intravenous sodium pamidronate and to define the role of osteocalcin assessment. The study included 61 patients diagnosed with osteogenesis imperfecta type 1 or 3, aged 2 to 18, hospitalized for intravenous sodium pamidronate administration.

pmc-12820166.title: Distributionally robust free energy principle for decision-making
pmc-12820166.creator: Allahkaram Shafiei, Hozefa Jesawada, Karl Friston, Giovanni Russo
pmc-12820166.description: Despite their groundbreaking performance, autonomous agents can misbehave when training and environmental conditions become inconsistent, with minor mismatches leading to undesirable behaviors or even catastrophic failures. Robustness towards these training-environment ambiguities is a core requirement for intelligent agents and its fulfillment is a long-standing challenge towards their real-world deployments.

pmc-12825240.title: Phylogenetic influence on gut microbiome diversity within an African herbivore community
pmc-12825240.creator: Rylee Jensen, Erin A McKenney, James C Beasley, Claudine C Cloete, Madeline Melton, Diana J R Lafferty
pmc-12825240.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe microbial community within the gastrointestinal tract, known as the gut microbiome (GMB), is a complex micro-ecosystem that is modulated by the life history and physiological traits of the host as well as environmental conditions experienced by the host. In addition, phylogeny can be an important driver of GMB variability across mammalian species, with closely-related species sharing more similar microbial communities than distantly-related species, an eco-evolutionary pattern known as phylosymbiosis.

pmc-12837113.title: Translation and cultural adaptation of the I-CAM-Q: the first Hungarian version for assessing complementary and alternative medicine use
pmc-12837113.creator: Tibor Rák, Anita Hegedűs, Eszter Molnár, Adrienne Csutak
pmc-12837113.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe International Questionnaire to Measure the Use of Complementary and Alternative Medicine (I-CAM-Q) is a standardized tool for assessing CAM use. While it has been adapted into several languages, this study presents the first Hungarian translation and cultural adaptation. Given the growing interest in CAM in Hungary, a validated Hungarian version is essential for accurate data collection and informed healthcare policy.MethodsThe I-CAM-Q was translated into Hungarian using a rigorous forward–backward translation protocol involving expert translators, proofreaders, and a reconciliation panel.

This was a retrospective, observational study involving 734 patients treated with ICIs between January 2016 and December 2022 in two Spanish hospitals.

pmc-13190769.title: Light-curing units in restorative dentistry: a clinically oriented narrative review of performance, selection, and emerging optical functions

pmc-13283625.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-13287768.title: Investigating the Reliability of the Novel Humeral Medial Epicondyle Fracture Classification
pmc-13287768.creator: Margaret Bowen, Alexandra Olson, Akbar Syed, Richard Lee, Divya Talwar, Benton Heyworth, Donna Pacicca, Scott McKay, Eric Edmonds, Matthew Ellington, Peter Fabricant, Daryl Osbahr, MEMO Study Group, J Todd Lawrence
pmc-13287768.description: Background:Recent literature has shown that the ulnar collateral ligament (UCL) and flexor pronator mass (FPM) can act either independently or jointly on the humeral medial epicondyle to produce distinct patterns of medial epicondyle fractures.Hypothesis:Assess the reliability and performance of a novel classification system for bony injuries of the humeral medial epicondyle.

pmc-13535232.title: Potato purple top phytoplasma infection induces autophagy-associated lipid dynamics that support pathogen proliferation
pmc-13535232.creator: Junichi Inaba, Bo Min Kim, Yan Zhao, Qi Huang, Wei Wei
pmc-13535232.description: Phytoplasmas are unculturable, phloem-restricted bacterial pathogens responsible for devastating diseases in crops and ornamentals worldwide. Their mechanism for nutrient acquisition from host plants remains largely unknown. This study demonstrated that infection with potato purple top phytoplasma induced extensive remodeling of lipid metabolism in tomato plants, closely linked to autophagy activation.

pmc-13608523.title: Renoprotective Effects of a Herbal Formulation Against Lipopolysaccharide-Induced Acute Kidney Injury Through Anti-Inflammatory and Antioxidant Activities
pmc-13608523.creator: Chen-Xuan Du, Cheng-Wei Huang, Tsung-Han Lee, Zhu-Yin Wang, Hui-Chun Ku
pmc-13608523.description: Sepsis-associated acute kidney injury (AKI) is a severe inflammatory complication with limited therapeutic options. This study investigated the protective effects of Taiwan Chingguan Yihau (NRICM101), a herbal formulation, against lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced AKI. Male C57BL/6 mice were injected with LPS to induce AKI in vivo, followed by therapeutic administration of NRICM101.

pmc-13632892.title: Small-Molecule-Mediated Depletion of the Dual-Specificity Tyrosine Phosphorylation-Regulated Kinase 1B (DYRK1B) Protein Scaffold
pmc-13632892.creator: Miriam Ems, Mattias F. Lindberg, Till Adhikary, Laurent Meijer, Matthias Lauth
pmc-13632892.description: Members of the DYRK kinase family have been implicated in the regulation of key metabolic processes. In particular, DYRK1B plays a central role in hepatic lipid metabolism and fatty liver disease. Notably, these functions depend not only on the enzyme’s catalytic activity but also on scaffolding properties.

pmc-5331226.title: Cellular senescence mediates fibrotic pulmonary disease
pmc-5331226.creator: Schafer MJ, White TA, Iijima K et al.
pmc-5331226.description: Peer-reviewed research article (PubMed Central). Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a fatal disease characterized by interstitial remodelling, leading to compromised lung function.
